subject: Inter-team rating reconciliation & anchor reset — plan and asks
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Team <peopleops@acmehr.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inter-team rating reconciliation & anchor reset — plan and asks

Team —

Thanks for carving time on short notice. As we wrap this calibration window, a few cross-team discrepancies popped up that won't resolve with the usual anchor discussions (different baselines, asymmetric evidence packets). I want to propose a short, focused reconciliation session to: 

- align on anchor examples across Eng/Product/CS
- reconcile 8–10 employees flagged as outlier by at least two raters
- agree on one stable anchor rater per band for the next rolling quarter

Attached is a one-page agenda and a draft calibration matrix. Please review before the meeting. Key asks: 

1) Vivek — can you bring the list of cross-functional anchor raters you recommended last quarter (we'll use as candidate anchors)
2) Laura — please pull the supporting evidence for the six outliers I flagged in folder "Q1-evals/exception-packages"
3) Neha — run a quick check on the promotion-eligible bucket so we don't conflate band drift with promotion exceptions

Proposed session: Wed Mar 3, 10:00–11:00 PT (30m structured agenda + 30m overflow). If we can't get consensus there, we'll run a short follow-up triage with HR present. Linda (PeopleOps) is cc'ed — want to make sure we have audit-ready notes.

Attachments: interteam_calibration_agenda_v1.pdf; calibration_matrix_v3.xlsx; anchor_examples.zip

Thanks — short pre-work will make the session useful.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Eng Management
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inter-team rating reconciliation & anchor reset — plan and asks

Vanessa —

Thanks, this is great. I can bring the candidate anchor list; quick note on format: the set I recommended last quarter includes two P3/P4 anchors that historically tilt conservative. I suggest we present them as "candidate anchors" rather than final anchors, and review any systematic tilt by running two paired comparisons (one conservative anchor + one neutral).

Also: can we carve out 10 minutes in the session to sign off on the anchor selection criteria (specific evidence types, minimum corroborating sources)? That will speed downstream decisions.

I'll attach the anchor roster as a quick spreadsheet tonight and flag any overlaps across teams.

—Vivek
VP, Infrastructure

Date: 2027-03-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inter-team rating reconciliation & anchor reset — plan and asks

Vanessa / all —

I pulled the exception packets for the six outliers and dropped them into the shared Drive folder (link in the agenda doc). Quick practical ask: for each outlier, please add a one-line note in the "evidence_summary" column of the calibration matrix before the meeting — it helps keep the discussion evidence-first.

Two examples I want on the table: 
- EmpID 8142 — strong project impact but inconsistent stakeholder feedback (CS flagged), manager documented mid-year coaching.
- EmpID 7791 — small cross-team contribution labeled early as "impactful" by single rater; no corroborating metrics.

If we can confirm the evidence framing ahead of time, we can make 10:00–11:00 very efficient.

Thanks — I'll be there with the packets and a proposed wording for any band adjustments (if we do them).

—Laura
Sr. Manager, Product Eng

Date: 2027-03-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inter-team rating reconciliation & anchor reset — plan and asks

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the invite. We can support the session and will join Wed Mar 3 at 10:00 PT. A couple of quick items from PeopleOps side: 

- We'll take minutes and capture any band changes so the audit trail is clear.
- We'll provide a short template for "anchor evidence" that maps directly to calibration_matrix_v3.xlsx — can you confirm which column you'd like us to populate?
- Post-session, we'll run a quick consistency check against historical distributions (to flag any anomalous drift) and share results within 48 hours.

We'll also send a pre-filled vendor view of the anchor roster (helpful for an external audit) after the meeting.

See you Wed.

—Linda Ramos
Senior Consultant, PeopleOps (Acme HR)
